readings.Aries: What you call confidence is sometimes the decision not to ask for help. Ask today. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.
readings.Taurus: Your relationship with money is your relationship with security. They are not the same thing. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Gemini: Your pattern recognition is excellent. The pattern you're missing is the one closest to you. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Cancer: You are allowed to need things. You are not required to justify the need first. There's more support available than you've asked for.
readings.Leo: The acknowledgment you need is sitting in a conversation you haven't started yet. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Virgo: You've been waiting for everything to be in place before you begin. It won't ever all be in place. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Libra: The version of events you're working to make fair was never quite fair to you. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Scorpio: The secret isn't protecting anyone anymore. Consider releasing it. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Sagittarius: Your faith that things will work out is usually warranted. Today, pair it with a concrete step. The week ahead rewards preparation you can still do today.
readings.Capricorn: Your integrity is one of your most defining qualities. It is also occasionally weaponised against yourself. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Aquarius: There is an idea you've been developing privately that needs exposure to become real. Share it. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Pisces: Your empathy absorbs what others discard. Check what you've been holding that isn't yours. The resistance you feel is pointing at something worth examining.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
